Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

UDC 658-71 1 *6 ( 083*22 ) : 621 '83062-2 : 629*124*72 



IS % 10868 -1984 




Indian Standard 

DATA SHEET FOR 

REVERSE/DIRECT REDUCTION GEAR BOX 

FOR FISHING VESSELS 



« 



1. Scope — Covers parameters required to be given by the manufacturer to the customers for the 
reverse/direct gear box for use with marine diesel engines. 

2. Data for the Gear Box — The gear box manufacturer shall specify the following: 

1) Designation given by the manufacturer : 

2) Type of control ( indicating mechanical/hydraulic or any other type ) 

3) a) Direction of rotation of output shaft as referred to input shaft 

with the engaging lever in the ahead position 

b) Direction of rotation of input shaft in any particular direction 

4) Reduction ratio ( Nominal ) in forward and in reverse 

5) Maximum thrust loading capacity 

6) i) Horse power/R. P. M. Combination 
ii) Maximum R. P. M. at input 

7) Maximum rated torque capacity: 

a) Ahead 

b) Astern 

8) Mounted lubricating oil pump capacity, where fitted 

9) Oil specification 

10) Sump capacity 

11) Oil change period 

12) Type and capacity of external cooling, if provided, along with inlet 
temperature and pressure 

13) Type of remote control, if offered 

14) Weight of the gear box 

15) Overall dimensions and installation drawing of the gear box 

16) Gauges and instruments provided ( standard and optional ), 
quantity and ranges 

17) Type of clutch 
( indicating dry type or wet type ) 

18) Clutch and housing mounting details 

19) Output coupling dimensions alongwith mating details, such as 
spigot/bolt holes ( normally output coupling is supplied with pilot 
bore ) 

20) Centre distance between input and output shafts 

21) Maximum permissible temperature rise of oil above ambient 
temperature under different operating conditions 

22) Gear box efficiency 

23) Approvals available from inspection authorities /classification 
societies 



Adopted 30 March 1984
